comments.author: Gao
comments.body: The problem with this ship is when it comes down to it and the evade melee skill fails, most ships due to fusion will kill you in melee within 2 rounds (maybe even 1 with roaring mines) but it's still a great ship, sadly just not in the same league as most decent maritime NC ships such a FFCV or MIS. still a good ship though, i mean who woul not want a MF with more sailors and chance to evade melee :3 (2~5b)
